from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0033.png"))
# Floor lamp base
# dark grey: R ~ 70-100, G ~ 70-100, B ~ 80-110
mask_lamp = (img[:, :, 0] > 65) & (img[:, :, 0] < 105) & \
            (img[:, :, 1] > 70) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & \
            (img[:, :, 2] > 80) & (img[:, :, 2] < 120) & \
            (img.shape[0] - np.arange(512)[:, None] < 200) # lower half

ys, xs = np.where(mask_lamp)
# Filter xs between 200 and 280
valid = (xs > 200) & (xs < 280) & (ys > 340) & (ys < 410)
ys_v = ys[valid]
xs_v = xs[valid]
print(f"Lamp base in 33: xs=[{xs_v.min()}, {xs_v.max()}], ys=[{ys_v.min()}, {ys_v.max()}], bottom={ys_v.max()}, cx={xs_v.mean():.1f}")
'
